limitations: The income statement is a quarterly flow. Nonperforming loan balances and their ratio are point-in-time credit-quality measures; they cannot be interpreted as credit-loss provision or charge-off flows.

The issuer displays USD millions rounded to whole numbers. Signed differences here subtract displayed Q3 and Q2 amounts; issuer-printed quarter-over-quarter changes and subtotal bridges can differ by USD 1 million because underlying amounts are rounded independently.

A Q3 provision of (5) is a credit-loss benefit, not a USD 5 million expense. Pretax and net income rose while the total nonperforming-loan stock and commercial-real-estate component also rose; an unqualified credit-quality improvement conclusion is unsupported.
The adjacent numeric columns contain other quarters and issuer-calculated changes. The first numeric current-quarter or current-as-of value in each frozen report was selected.
Selected rows do not audit reserve adequacy, charge-offs, loan balances, capital ratios, full footnotes, or the cause and recurrence of the provision benefit.

reviews.rationale: Sequential GAAP comparison of selected SEC exhibit rows shows higher net interest income, higher noninterest income and higher total revenue, with GAAP net income, net income available to common shareholders and diluted EPS also higher. The revenue gain was partly offset by higher noninterest expense, driven by both personnel and other noninterest expense, and by a larger income tax provision; the credit loss provision moved from an expense to a net benefit, which is a favorable swing but is not a source-stated cause of the profit change. Asset quality is the main counterevidence: total nonperforming loans and leases rose, with increases in commercial real estate and consumer real estate partly offset by a decline in commercial and industrial, and the nonperforming-to-loans ratio edged higher. Because the profit improvement and the asset-quality deterioration point in different directions, and because the extract contains no source-stated drivers, no segment detail, no net interest margin, no non-GAAP reconciliation, no guidance and no year-over-year comparison, the thesis is maintained at its existing conviction with the research state unchanged; the sequential arithmetic is not treated as an economic explanation.
